newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BALOISE SOARS ON CS/WINTERTHUR DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BALOISE SOARS ON CS/WINTERTHUR DEAL.

text.p: Shares in Swiss insurer Baloise Holding shot up 7.5 percent on takeover speculation after insurer Winterthur said it planned to merge with bank concern Credit Suisse Group .
Baloise registered shares were 280 Swiss francs or 7.5 percent higher at 3,990 francs after the first hour of trading, during whcih they went as high as 4,005.
Traders said the CS/Winterthur deal prompted speculation that Baloise, which offers life and non-life insurance, could merge with a partner or be bought.
Baloise is the fourth-biggest Swiss insurer after number three Winterthur, with market capitalisation of just over four billion Swiss francs.
